title: Perfunctorily
summary: PERFUNC'TORILY, adverb [Latin perfunctorie, from perfungor; per and fungor, to do or execute.] Carelessly; negligently; in a manner to satisfy external form.

inlines.v: PERFUNC'TORILY, adverb [Latin perfunctorie, from perfungor; per and fungor, to do or execute.] Carelessly; negligently; in a manner to satisfy external form.
